channel.title: Nicotine Science and Policy
channel.description: Daily digest of views, debates and discussions on nicotine science, policy, regulation and advocacy.

item.title: New Rules In Effect
item.description: New UK rules effective from the end of October restrict the sale and promotion of vaping and nicotine products. Sales are limited to adults aged 18 or over, and adults cannot buy them on behalf of minors. Vending machines selling these and related products are prohibited, as are promotional free samples, substantial discounts and coupons. Enforcement authorities can issue fixed penalty notices for a range of offences. (Published on November 03, 2026byplanetofthevapes.co.uk)

item.title: Respiratory symptoms among never-established smokers who vape: a multiregional cross-sectional survey of 1,519 adults
item.description: A new study published inBMC Pulmonary Medicine, involving 1,519 adults across six world regions, found no clinically meaningful difference in respiratory symptom frequency between exclusive vapers and non-vapers without an established smoking history. (Published on November 03, 2026byspringer.com)

item.title: We Vape’s Mark Oates: Why Resist Harm Reduction?
item.description: The UK's contrasting treatment of snus, nicotine pouches and heated tobacco raises questions about the consistency of its approach to tobacco harm reduction. (Published on November 03, 2026byasiantrader.biz)

item.title: Vape bans and tougher rules: the South Caucasus takes different paths
item.description: Azerbaijan, Armenia and Georgia are taking markedly different approaches to nicotine regulation across the South Caucasus. (Published on November 03, 2026by2firsts.com)
